name: assignment-requires-reviewer-role
purpose: An account that does not hold the reviewer role cannot be assigned to a proposal (AssignmentValidity: the reviewer holds the reviewer role).

given.text: Quorum is running with a published call, an officer, a chair, applicants and verified reviewers

when.text: the officer assigns bob, another applicant who is not a reviewer, to p1

then.text: the assignment is refused as not_a_reviewer
